pin.surface: starter (default; the cell's gbrain.surface picks starter or verbs, internal-task)

embeddings.default: off (gbrain init --no-embedding; import --no-embed): search is keyword-only and the brain makes no model or embedding call
embeddings.not_gbrain_default: gbrain's new-install default is voyage:voyage-4; this repository has no Voyage key, so the embedded brains use gbrain's documented OpenAI alternative, priced in runner/pricing/embedding-pricing.ts at $0.02 per million tokens
embeddings.route: requests leave through OPENAI_BASE_URL only, pointing at the metering proxy's slot URL (http://host.docker.internal:<port>/<slot>/openai); gbrain treats a configured base URL as satisfying the OpenAI key requirement and sends Bearer unauthenticated at the image build (the build's slot is tokenless); a served sidecar sends the proxy slot's per-trial token (HE_GBRAIN_PROXY_TOKEN, handed to gbrain as OPENAI_API_KEY) and nothing without it is forwarded; the proxy injects the key on the host and meters each /v1/embeddings call; no key in the container or the build, only the trial's token, which authorizes nothing once its slot is unbound
embeddings.build: scripts/build-gbrain-image.sh --embedded: the builder stage run as a container with /brain bind-mounted, build-brain.ts --embeddings <model> (init --embedding-model, import, embed --stale --catch-up --json --yes), the proxy's usage summary written into the brain's manifest.json, then the embedded Dockerfile target
embeddings.brains: /brains/dev-embedded and /brains/heldout-embedded, bot-visible only; served when the cell's gbrain.embeddings names the model (HE_GBRAIN_EMBEDDINGS)
embeddings.query_embed_timeout_note: GBRAIN_QUERY_EMBED_TIMEOUT_MS the entrypoint sets for an embedded brain (gbrain's default is 6000): past it gbrain continues keyword-only and stamps search_degraded, so a semantic trial with a degraded stamp is excluded (HE-GBRAIN-005, runner); the value is above the proxy round trip measured in the ladder's smoke at parallel 3

pin.model_calls: none from a keyword brain; an embedded brain embeds each search, query or recall query through OPENAI_BASE_URL (the metering proxy), metered per trial; the sidecar environment carries no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY

serve_env.GBRAIN_HOME: /brain (a per-trial copy of /brains/$HE_GBRAIN_SPLIT; the brain records absolute paths, so it is served where it was built)
serve_env.GBRAIN_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN: 64 random hex characters minted per trial, never written anywhere
serve_env.GBRAIN_REMOTE_PRIVATE_PAGES: 1 for a company brain only (HE_GBRAIN_BRAIN=company); unset for bot-visible
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_BRAIN: bot-visible | company | member: which /brains entry the entrypoint copies to /brain
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_SCOPE: none | member | sources: with member the entrypoint also copies the company or member brain's tokens.json to $HE_GBRAIN_OUT for the world's tap, which presents the requesting member's token per turn; with sources the manifest's grants, for per-request source_ids
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_INGEST: off | live: with live (member brain only) the entrypoint copies ingest-tokens.json (one token per source) to $HE_GBRAIN_OUT for the world's live ingestion (internal-task)
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_SURFACE: starter | verbs: the --surface the entrypoint passes to gbrain serve (internal-task)
serve_env.HE_GBRAIN_EMBEDDINGS: off | openai:text-embedding-3-small: with a model the entrypoint serves /brains/<split>-embedded and requires OPENAI_BASE_URL (internal-task)
serve_env.OPENAI_BASE_URL: the metering proxy slot URL, embedded brains only; a route, never a key

pin.auth: gbrain auth create trial-<trial id>; the bearer token gbrain_<hex> goes to $HE_GBRAIN_OUT/token (mode 0600) and nowhere else; only the world's /gbrain tap presents it; under scope member the tap presents the requesting member's build-time token from tokens.json instead, and public-only before the first turn
pin.wire: POST /mcp, Authorization: Bearer <token>, Accept: application/json, text/event-stream; replies are SSE-framed JSON-RPC (event: message / data: {...}); GET /mcp is 405; /health is unauthenticated
pin.image: harness-eval/gbrain:dev (gbrain/Dockerfile, built from the repository root with -f gbrain/Dockerfile or scripts/build-gbrain-image.sh); /brains/dev, /brains/heldout, /brains/dev-company and /brains/heldout-company with manifest.json each (tokens.json beside the company brains), /install (the install bundle, internal-task); the embedded target adds /brains/dev-embedded and /brains/heldout-embedded; the company-brain run builds the same Dockerfile as harness-eval/gbrain:company and passes --gbrain-image so the gbrain arm's :dev tag is untouched while that arm runs
pin.reaches: the host loopback only, through a published port; the harness container reaches gbrain only through the world's POST /gbrain tap

brains.bot-visible: /brains/<split>: one default source, built by gbrain/build-brain.ts --brain bot-visible (the gbrain arm)
brains.member: /brains/<split>-member (internal-task): the bot-visible slice (non-DM channel pages and public files) in one federated source per reader set as the company brain names them (a channel page in its channel's reader-set source, a public file in public), plus an empty source for every loaded non-DM channel without a page and an empty private-<member> source per employee and agent; the same member tokens and public-only token as the company brain in tokens.json, plus one ingest token per source (auth create ingest-<source>; auth rescope --token ingest-<source> --sources <source>) in ingest-tokens.json, whose write source is that source; manifest.json schema_version 3 carries ingest.channels (channel id to source) for the world's live ingestion, which writes each message of the scenario as a remember fact with provenance into the source of its conversation (a DM with the bot into private-<member>)
brains.company: /brains/<split>-company: one federated gbrain source per distinct reader set (public, private-<member>, team-<short>, team-<short>-members, channel-<name>, readers-<8 hex>), every source created with gbrain sources add <id> --path <staging dir> --force --federated and imported with gbrain import <dir> --source <id> --no-embed --allow-noncanonical-root --json; one bearer token per employee and agent (auth create member-<id>; auth rescope --token member-<id> --sources private-<id>,<every source whose readers include the member>) plus public-only (--sources public), the secrets in tokens.json (mode 0600 in the brain directory; world-readable inside the image layer, which is built and used on one machine and never pushed to a registry); served with GBRAIN_REMOTE_PRIVATE_PAGES=1 so visibility: private pages are served like every other page (gbrain's default hides them from every remote caller; internal-task report)
